_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: Batıda bağımsız bir ada. Hatta... Gitmek istersen...
The Envoy Part I#000.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: Gözden kaçırmak gerçekten zor. Atla gitsin!

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: Mo'in, Wynn yolcusu! Gel, benle konuş.

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: Kuzeyde silah ve iksir alabilirsin. Kapıdan devam edersen yerli Avos'ları bulursun.
The Envoy Part I#005.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: Batıda zırh alabilirsin, iksir dükkânının bir başka girişi de orada.
The Envoy Part I#006.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: Lokantada bir şeyler oluyor, acele etsen iyi olur.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: Mo'in, Wynnli. Çok şükür seni durdurabildim!
The Envoy Part I#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...
The Envoy Part I#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: Bilmiyorsun, değil mi? Tabii ki bilmiyorsun. Açıklayayım.

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: Bu arada adım Maxie. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.
The Envoy Part I#012.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...
The Envoy Part I#013.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: Bak... Yabancı olduğunu biliyorum ama... Yardım etmek istersen benimle konuş.

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
The Envoy Part I#015.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: Bak, s-seni yavaşlattığım için özür dilerim. Sadece...

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: Aa, iki yol var. Hangisi doğru bilmiyorum, ayrılalım. Ben sağa gidiyorum.

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: Mo'in. Kusura bakma, bir sorunum vardı da-
The Envoy Part I#020.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: Muhafızları dert etme, şimdilik devre dışılar. Beni takip et!
The Envoy Part I#022.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: Bir makine gördük… Yeni bir makine! Farklı görünüyordu, sanki şurada yapılmış gibi-
The Envoy Part I#023.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: Misafirimiz... birkaç despermech'i tek başına haklayıverdi.
The Envoy Part I#024.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: Sv. {~} olunca evime gel, içeri girebilmen için al sana bir anahtar. Fabrikaya sızmaya hazırlanmalıyız.
The Envoy Part I#025.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Wynn temsilcileri arıyoruz. Corkus'u görmek istersen aşağıda iskeledeki C.S.S Wavebreaker'a git. Gidersen Corkus'un tadını çıkar!
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: {p} iskelesinde C.S.S Wavebreaker Kaptanı ile konuş.

The Envoy Part I#035.dst: C.S.S Wavebreaker'a hoş geldin, hoş geldin!
The Envoy Part I#035.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: Gemime hoş geldin, seni doğruca Corkus'a götürcem.
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Bana güven, Gavel'den de Wynn'den de çok daha harika. Bizde makine bile var!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.dst: Bana güven, buralarda keyfin yerinde olcak.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Bir Wynn askerinin adamızı ziyaret etmesi büyük onur.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: Gerçek bir elçi umuyorduk ama sen de iş görürsün.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: Beni takip edersen sana şehri gezdireyim.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: Corkus'a ilk kez {~} yıl önce geldik.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Corkian'lar da senin gibi aslen Fruma'lı...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Fruma'dan geldiğimiz için elbette hiç büyü bilmiyorduk.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: Kısa sürede kendi büyümüzü geliştirdik. Nadir bir güç: Elektrobüyü.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: Makine yapmamızı sağlayan, zorlu ve modern bir büyü dalı.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: Aa, geldik bile. Adamızın başkenti {p} şehrine hoş geldin.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: Güneyde bankamız, toz dükkânı, parşömenler ve bize özel toz takas yeri var!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: Aa! Toz takas yeri demişken, başlangıç için sana bunlardan biraz vereyim.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: Devam edelim... Güney kapısı {p} bölgesine çıkar. Yolda şunun yanından geçebilirsin-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: Şey, boş ver. Aslında sana bir hediyemiz var.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner adanın bütün misafirlerini ağırlıyor.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Batı kapısından geç ve bedava ziyafetin için lokantaya git. Afiyet olsun!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: The Five Gears Diner'a doğru yürü.

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: Bir şey yapmadan önce burada neler olduğunu anlatmam lazım...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.dst: Makineler gittikçe daha çaresiz hâle geliyor.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: Onları temizlemeye çalıştık ama fabrika hep yenisini yapıyor.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: Corkus'un en büyük başarısızlığı bu. Durdurulması lazım.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: Gizlice girmek için havalandırmayı açmayı deneyebilirim.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: Yabancı olduğunu biliyorum ama yardım etmek istersen benimle konuş.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: Ah! En basit büyüyü bile yapamıyorum!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: Senin önünde böyle işe yaramaz olduğum için özür dilerim...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: Elektrobüyü senin büyünden farklı.. Ben pek iyi değilim...
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.
The Envoy Part I#095.dst: Kapıyı aç ve havalandırma kanallarından çık.

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...Şuradaki hurda yığınının tepesindeki makine de ne öyle?!
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: O kesinlikle sıradan bir despermech değil... Yepyeni görünüyor!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: Fabrika çalıştığından beri onlardan biri görülmemişti...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: Bir şey yapmalıyız! Ben senin için yolu açarım. Yapabileceğim tek şey bu, ben... bacağımı... incittim.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: İyi misin? Güzel. Buluştuğumuz girişte görüşelim. {p} yönetimine haber vermeliyiz!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: The Five Gears Diner'ın girişinde Maxie ile konuş.

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.dst: Bir kestirme biliyorum, {p} şehrine hemen varırız.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#112.dst: {p} içinde Maxie ve Corkus Delegesi ile konuş.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#114.dst: Beltrude, bir sorunumuz var! Fabrika çalışıyor!
The Envoy Part I#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#116.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#116.dst: Ne saçmalık! Misafirimizin önünde bundan bahsetmemelisin!
The Envoy Part I#116.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#118.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#118.dst: Hem basit bir elektrobüyüyü bile yapamayan birinin sözüne neden güvenelim?
The Envoy Part I#118.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#119.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#119.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#120.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.dst: Sen buradayken hiçbir şeyi kabul etmezler. Wynn ile müttefik olmak istiyorlar.
The Envoy Part I#120.speaker: Maxie
